about.en: MAon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Mastercard, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by MA shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xA29dC2102dfc2a0A4A5dCb84Af984315567c9858, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
